content:
I am looking for a fully funded PhD or Postdoc to work on topics such as Quantum software or Cryptographic software (program verification, compilation) and compilers for proof assistants.

You will work in the the section of Programming Languages, Logic and Software Security of the Department of Computer Science, Aarhus University.

Interested applicants with strong analytical skills are encouraged to contact me asap by DM or e-mail (spitters@cs.au.dk) with a CV and a short description of interests.

Details on our PhD school: https://phd.nat.au.dk/for-applicants

Bas Spitters
Aarhus University, Department of Computer Science
